=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3854-3859 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The post-commit retrigger guard skips verification using only `DID_COMMIT` and `CONFLICT_RESOLVED`, unlike the gate job which also checks the autofix commit prefix and bot identity.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers flagged the inconsistency; if this path is reached with unexpected state, it can bypass the stricter gate logic and skip verification without confirming the commit is an `[ai-autofix]` bot commit.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:198-202 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `[ai-autofix]` prefix and GitHub login comparisons are case-sensitive, so legitimate autofix commits with different casing will miss the skip path.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the pattern match and login equality checks can fail on case variations, causing unnecessary verification runs instead of skipping them.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:186-191 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The commit-metadata probe fails open on `gh api` errors and has no retry protection, so transient API failures force a full verification run.
  WHY: Several reviewers noted that any temporary GitHub API failure makes the skip logic unavailable for that run, defeating the cost-saving path.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:186-186 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `split("\n")[0]` can yield an empty first line, which prevents the `[ai-autofix]` prefix check from matching.
  WHY: Both reviewers pointed out that an empty subject line, while unusual, would cause the skip to be missed even for a valid autofix commit.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:200-202 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `[ -n "${bot_login}" ]` test is redundant because `bot_login` always falls back to `codex`.
  WHY: Reviewers consistently described this as dead code with no runtime effect.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:201-202 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The bot-login comparison is case-sensitive.
  WHY: The reviewers who raised this noted GitHub logins are effectively case-insensitive, so mixed-case values could prevent the skip from triggering.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:180-181 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The skip condition checks `EVENT_NAME == 'pull_request'` and `EVENT_ACTION == 'synchronize'`, which the reviewer believes may be unreachable in the reusable workflow path.
  WHY: The reviewer argued that if the reusable workflow sees `workflow_call` instead of the original PR event, the self-triggered skip path never executes.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:198-199 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `[ai-autofix]` prefix match is case-sensitive.
  WHY: The reviewer said mixed-case variants such as `[AI-AUTOFIX]` would miss the skip and waste a verification run.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:200-202 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The GitHub login comparison is case-sensitive.
  WHY: The reviewer noted that a differently cased bot login could fail the equality test and prevent the skip.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:200-202 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The check `[ -n "${bot_login}" ]` is redundant because `bot_login` always has a default.
  WHY: The reviewer identified this as dead code with no runtime impact.
- agents.md, README.md | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Documentation says the feature checks “author email”, but the code checks `.author.login` and `.committer.login`.
  WHY: The reviewer said the docs and implementation disagree, which can confuse maintainers and reviewers.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:186-191 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The `gh api` call has no retry mechanism.
  WHY: The reviewer said transient GitHub API failures could force unnecessary verification runs.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3854-3859 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The post-commit retrigger guard only checks `DID_COMMIT=true && CONFLICT_RESOLVED!=true`.
  WHY: The reviewer said it does not re-check the commit prefix or bot identity, so it is weaker than the gate job.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:186 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Commit message extraction only captures the first line, so an empty first line prevents the skip match.
  WHY: The reviewer said `split("\n")[0]` can return an empty string, which makes the `[ai-autofix]` case pattern fail.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:198 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Prefix matching for `[ai-autofix]` is case-sensitive.
  WHY: The reviewer said mixed-case variants like `[AI-AUTOFIX]` or `[Ai-Autofix]` would bypass the skip.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3854-3859 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The post-commit retrigger skip logic is looser than the gate job’s skip logic.
  WHY: The reviewer said this path skips on local state flags only and does not mirror the gate job’s commit-metadata checks.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:186-191 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `gh api` call lacks retry logic and the login comparison is case-sensitive.
  WHY: The reviewer said transient API errors and casing differences can make the skip fail open or miss legitimate bot commits.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

  PROBLEM: The post-commit retrigger step lacks the identity and prefix verification used by the gate job.

  PROBLEM: The `[ai-autofix]` prefix match is case-sensitive.
  WHY: The reviewer said uppercase or mixed-case variants would not match and would force a redundant verification pass.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:200-202 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `[ -n "${bot_login}" ]` check is redundant.
  WHY: The reviewer said `bot_login` is already guaranteed non-empty by the default assignment.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:186-191 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `gh api` call lacks retry protection.
  WHY: The reviewer said transient GitHub API failures can make the gate fail open and run the full verification pass unnecessarily.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:201-202 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Login comparison is case-sensitive.
  WHY: The reviewer said a differently cased bot login could cause the skip to fail.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

  PROBLEM: The `[ -n "${bot_login}" ]` condition is always true.

=== FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:185-202 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Identity comparison is case-sensitive, so a differently cased `AUTOFIX_BOT_LOGIN` or login response can prevent the skip.
  WHY: The reviewer said the literal string comparisons can miss legitimate bot commits and waste the verification pass.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:198 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `[ai-autofix]` prefix match is case-sensitive.
  WHY: The reviewer said case variants like `[AI-AUTOFIX]` or `[Ai-Autofix]` bypass the skip.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:191-196 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Extracting `split("\n")[0]` can yield an empty first line, which prevents the prefix match.
  WHY: The reviewer said an empty subject line produces an empty `head_msg_line`, so the skip never triggers.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:200-201 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `[ -n "${bot_login}" ]` check is redundant.
  WHY: The reviewer said the default value makes the test always true.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:200-202 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The post-commit retrigger step skips without the same prefix-and-identity checks as the gate job.
  WHY: The reviewer said this creates an inconsistent security boundary and could skip verification based only on local state.
